book.name: 2 Timocheyo
book.title: Baluwa jhuubhele jha Pauli kwa Timocheyo

content: Nkomboka kubhehe mu machiko gha ghukupehekela ghapakubhehe ndi machiko gha malagho.
Bhando nabhakipala bhene, nabhapala mbijha na bhibhakikweya na bhina ngandango nabhannigha Chapanga, na bhangajhokanikiya akatate bhabhe, na bhangaluchenguu na bhangannyinamii Chapanga.
Bhando bheniya nabhabha bhanga mapalano na bhangapala kujhelana na bhina uwange na bhahoto jhe kukilongocha na bhina ukale na bhangapala ghambone.
Bhando bheniya nabhabha bhibhajhambii bhajhabhe na bhihenga changaholelela na bhibhakiloka na bhibhakipala bhene kuliku kumpala Chapanga.
Kwa panja nabhabhonekana ngita bhando bhibhannomba Chapanga, nambo bhikana makakala ghake. Mkibhambahe hake na bhando ngita bheniya.
Pakate jha bhando bhange bhijhenda munyumba jha bhando na kwakolowa akakeghe mandindilima bhibhatopilwilwe na mihigho jha uhakaho na bhibhalongochwa na tama mboho jha kila kilebhe.
Akakeghe bheniya bhijhigha kukibhola kila lichiko nambo bhihoto jhe kuhikii kuumanya uchakaka.
Bhando bheniya bhikana uchakaka ngita Yane na Yambule chibhankanila Mucha. Bheniya ndi bhando bhibhahobhite mu malango ghabhe na bhakanilwe mu ilebhe ya kihobholelo.
Nambo nabhahoto ng'o kujhendele hake nhwalo undindilima gwabhe naubhonekana hotuhotu kwa bhando bhoha, ngita chikibha kwa Yane na Yambule.

Nambo mwenga ma Timocheyo, maghakengime mabholo ghango na matyangilo ghango na chimbala mu kutama kwango. Na hele mukikengime kihobholelo chango na kuhimbilila kwango na mapalano ghango na kulendele kwango,

kubulwa kwango na kulagha kwango. Kabhele mughamanye ghighangolile kwenio ku Antiyokiya na ku Ikonilo na ku Lusita. Ngaimbilila kulagha kwenio kukolongwa muno! Nambo Bhambo ngang'ombwila mugheniya ghoha.
Kila mundo jwaipala kutama kwa kunhalalii Chapanga mu kulombana na Kilichitu Yecho nalagha.
Bhando bhanganandela na bhibhakoloya nabhajhendelela kubhehe bhanganandela hake, na bhibhakoloya bhange na kongo bhene bhikopokewa.
Nambo mwenga nnyendelele kutama mu uchakaka ghola ghumolitwe punyeketila. Nhwalo mamanye bhala bhibhamolita,
na nkomboka kuhumii uhwana gwino mughamanye Majhandiko gha Chapanga gheniya ghahotwii kunete malango ghinnongocha mu ughombokeko kwa kuhobholela Kilichitu Yecho.
Majhandiko ghoha gha Chapanga ghabhii na Uhuke gwa Chapanga na ghahoto kunyangatii kubhola chakaka na kukelebhuya na kulangii malemo na kwalongocha bhando bhatame maha palonge jha Chapanga,
mundo jwantumikii Chapanga abhaha na kila kilebhe chakipala mukuntumikii Chapanga na ahoto kuhenga mahengo ghoha ghambone.
